description: This file is a PHP script that acts as a web server endpoint for handling vCalendar free/busy information related to SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It initializes a WebDAV server for vCal data, used primarily for synchronizing free/busy schedules with Outlook clients.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server_vCal
classes.description: A class responsible for handling WebDAV requests for vCalendar free/busy data.

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming WebDAV requests for vCalendar data.
